headline: LIAM'S 🥁 TAMBOURINE 😁 GRIN And CHARLI 👋 BYE TO BRAT - Music 📸 Awards 2026 Shortlist 🔥
text:
LIAM 🧔 GALLAGHER'S 🥁 tambourine 😁 GRIN 😬 facing 😵 Oasis 🏜️ fans 👥 at 🏟️ Wembley 🏟️ is 🔥 NOMINATED 🏆 in the live 🎤 music 🎶 category 🏷️ as part 🧩 of the Abbey 🛣️ Road 📍 Music 🎸 Photography 📸 Awards 🏅 shortlist 📋 this year 📅 after they sifted 🕵️ through a whopping 24500 📈 submissions 📦 from 42 🌍 different countries 🇬🇧🇺🇸!! The images 🖼️ of Oasis 🏜️ reunion 🤝 tour 🚌 and Charli 👩‍🎤 XCX 🟩 bringing 🧳 Brat 🟩 to Glastonbury 🎪 are getting their moment 🌟 too while Kendrick 🧢 Lamar 🎤 Fontaines 🪨 DC Tame 🐆 Impala and Sombr 🌑 also SLIDE 🛝 into the nominated 📸 shots 📷 along with FKA 🌿 Twigs 🧚 selected 🏅 out of competition 🏅 for those juicy 🍑 judges 🧑‍⚖️ awards 🏆!!

All finalist 🏁 photographs 📸 will get displayed 🖥️ in the LED 💡 tunnel 🕳️ at Outernet 🏙️ London 🏰 from 8️⃣ to 14️⃣ September 🍂 including the five 🖐️ pieces 🧩 picked 🏗️ for the fan voted 🗳️ music 🎵 moment 🕰️ of the year 🗓️ award 🏆!! Voting 🗳️ is live 📡 online 💻 via the official 🌐 website 🕸️ and in person 👤 at the exhibition 🖼️ while the winners 🏆 get announced 📣 at a ceremony 🎉 at the London 🏙️ studios 🏢 made famous 🌟 by the 1969 🕰️ Beatles 🎸 album 💿 of the same name 🏷️ on 24 September 🗓️!! Jack 🧔 Oliver's 📸 snapshot 📷 of Charli 👩‍🎤 XCX 🔥 burning 🔥 down the Brat 🟩 flag 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 at Glastonbury 🎪 to signal 🚦 the end 🏁 of an era 🕰️ is also up 🆙 for best 🥇 music 🎶 moment 🕰️ of the year 🗓️!!

Head judge 👨‍⚖️ British 🇬🇧 photographer 📸 and director 🎬 Rankin 🧔 said 🗣️ 2026 🗓️ feels like the strongest 💪 year 🗓️ yet for the awards 🏆 which began 5️⃣ years ago 🕰️!! The quality 🏅 of the work 🛠️ entered 🚪 was genuinely exceptional 🌟 not just technically 🔧 brilliant 💎 but full 🥛 of energy ⚡ emotion 😢 and a real point 🧭 of view 👀 he added 🗣️ while music 🎸 photography 📸 is in a really exciting 🎢 place 🗺️ right now and these awards 🏆 are a brilliant snapshot 📸 of that vibe 🌊!! This year's 🗓️ guest category 🏷️ celebrates 🎉 50 years 🕰️ of punk 🤘 and it was previously announced 📢 that photographers 📸 Roberta 🧓 Bayley and Masayoshi 🧿 Sukita will both receive special 🏆 recognition 🏅 on the night 🌙!!

The judging panel 🧑‍⚖️ includes artists 🎨 from around the worlds 🌍 of music 🎶 and photography 📸 including Chic 🎷 guitarist 🎸 and producer 🎛️ Nile 🐊 Rogers and Brit 🏆 Award winning singer 🎤 Raye 🌟!! Here are some more eye catching 👀 nominees 🏅 like Liam 🧔 right and Noel 🧔 Gallagher of Oasis 🏜️ sharing a moment 🕰️ on stage 🎤 but off mic 🎙️ during their band's penultimate 🏟️ Wembley 🏟️ Stadium show of their 2025 comeback tour 🚌 in the music 🎵 moment 🕰️ of the year 🗓️ category 🏷️ shot 📷 by Harriet 🧔‍♀️ T K Bols!! An image 🖼️ of a single Oasis 🏜️ fan caught in the middle of the swirling 🌪️ chaotic movement of the River Plate stadium crowd in Buenos Aires 🇦🇷 Argentina is up in the music 🎶 moment 🕰️ category 🏷️ by photographer 📸 Joshua 🧔 Halling while the New York band Geese 🪿 pictured clearing out their studio space ahead of a photo shoot 📸 lands in the behind the scenes 🕵️ category 🏷️ by Lewis 🧔 Evans!!

A fisheye 🐟 portrait 🖼️ of The OGM one half of the group HO99O9 smiling 😁 while displaying his custom grill 🦷 is nominated 🏆 in the portrait 🖼️ category 🏷️ by Daniel 🧔 Rojos and surrounded by performers 🎭 in red ❤️ white ⚪ and blue 🔵 forming the US 🇺🇸 flag 🏴󠁵󠁳󠁡󠁦󠁬󠁡󠁧󠁿 Kendrick 🧢 Lamar takes centre stage 🎤 at the Super Bowl 🏈 halftime show in the music 🎵 moment 🕰️ category 🏷️ captured 📸 by Jenn 🧔‍♀️ Devereaux!! Yorkshire singer songwriter Billie 🧔‍♀️ Marten riding a white 🐴 horse at sunset 🌅 in Aotearoa New Zealand is in the emerging photographer 📸 of the year 🗓️ category 🏷️ by Frances 🧔‍♀️ Carter while metal fans 🤘 at Download Festival form a human pyramid 🏔️ on the campsite in the festivals 🎪 category 🏷️ shot 📷 by Danny 🧔 North!! Fontaines 🪨 DC rocking 🤘 out at a festival 🎪 in their native Ireland opposite a ferris wheel 🎡 in the live 🎤 music 🎶 category 🏷️ by Charlie 🧔 Barclay Harris shows what a ride 🎢 it has been for the band who also headlined Reading and Leeds this year 🗓️!!

Phoebe 🧔‍♀️ Lunny of Brighton band Lambrini Girls jumping backwards from the top of speakers 📢 and down into a sea 🌊 of hands 🖐️ held aloft in the crowd to catch her is nominated 🏆 in the music 🎵 moment 🕰️ category 🏷️ by Jessie 🧔‍♀️ Morgan and US singer songwriter Sombr 🌑 playing or resting his hands on a piano 🎹 backwards while looking directly into the camera 📸 lands in the emerging photographer 📸 category 🏷️ by Bryce 🧔 Glenn!! Punks 🤘 with Dolly and Harriet featuring Ian Anderson who became the singer with Crazyhead and Robber Byker who went on to be the bass player with Gaye Bykers on Acid taken in Leicester in 1979 is up in the 50 years of punk 🤘 category 🏷️ by Wayne 🧔 Spike Large while Kevin Parker of Tame 🐆 Impala has a moment of blissful solitude on the low lit set of the music video for his track Loser in the behind the scenes 🕵️ category 🏷️ by Caity 🧔‍♀️ Krone!! Australian punk rock band Private Function playing one of their last gigs at a party on Gold Street Melbourne with Chris Penney diving into the backyard crowd is in the underground scenes 🕳️ category 🏷️ by Suzanne 🧔‍♀️ Phoenix and an upside down 🔄 shot 📸 of Amyl and the Sniffers frontwoman Amy Taylor crowd surfing the very low ceilings of Soda Bar in San Diego in 2019 is nominated in the 50 years of punk 🤘 category 🏷️ by Jamie 🧔 Wdziekonski!! FKA 🌿 Twigs and her dancers letting out a collective primal scream while headlining the LadyLand Festival at Under the K Bridge Park in Brooklyn as part of Rolling Stone magazine coverage celebrating queer talent and gay icons is selected for the judges 🧑‍⚖️ award 🏆 by Sacha 🧔 Lecca and yeah the whole thing cooks 🔥 different bro!!
